morning_context.market_summary: U.S. futures are rebounding on June 18 after Wednesday's Fed-driven selloff, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures higher while VIX is back near 17 and the 10-year yield is slightly lower around 4.44%. The setup is constructive for selective long trades in liquid, catalyst-backed semiconductors, but the cash-market backdrop is still damaged by hawkish Fed repricing and yesterday's broad index losses, so this is not a broad risk-on day.

market_thesis.primary_swing_theory: Over the next 2-10 trading days, liquid semiconductor and memory names can lead a relief bounce if the Fed shock stops pushing yields higher, VIX keeps fading, and AI/memory demand catalysts attract fresh institutional buying. The thesis fails if Nasdaq futures strength reverses after the open, VIX reclaims the high teens, or semis lose VWAP while rates rise.
drivers: Fed held rates but signaled possible future hikes, creating a rebound-with-rate-risk tape.
Intel has a fresh Apple domestic-chip manufacturing headline and memory names are supported by Apple price-increase commentary tied to memory/storage costs.
VIX is down near 17 and the 10-year yield is slightly lower, supporting a selective relief bid.
Juneteenth closure tomorrow can compress activity and increase late-day position trimming.
what_would_change_my_mind: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 give back the premarket bounce and trade below the first-hour range.
VIX reverses above 18.5 while the 10-year yield pushes back above 4.50%.
SMH/semiconductor leaders lose VWAP in the first hour despite positive catalysts.
Intel or Micron trade below their planned stop references on volume.
market_thesis.crowding_assessment: medium: the semiconductor bounce is visible in premarket mover lists and analyst headlines, so entries must require VWAP and opening-range confirmation rather than chasing the first print.

regime_scorecard.rule: risk_on requires at least 5 bullish factors and no more than 1 bearish factor; otherwise use neutral/risk_off.

sp500_trend.evidence: Investopedia reported S&P 500 futures +0.8% early June 18, but Barron's reported the S&P 500 fell 1.2% on June 17 after the Fed.

qqq_trend.evidence: Investopedia reported Nasdaq 100 futures +1.4%, but Barron's reported the Nasdaq fell 1.3% on June 17 and the profile's last observation warned that Nasdaq weakness can coexist with low VIX.

small_cap_breadth.evidence: No reliable June 18 small-cap breadth source was verified within the 10-search budget.

vix_direction.evidence: Yahoo Finance showed VIX near 17.13, down about 7.1%, and Investing.com showed S&P 500 VIX 17.13, down about 7.05%.

ten_year_yield.evidence: Investing.com showed the U.S. 10Y around 4.437%, down about 0.020, while Investors.com cited 4.46% premarket.

sector_breadth.evidence: Premarket leadership was concentrated but broad within semiconductors and storage: Investing.com listed INTC, ON, WDC, LRCX, KLAC, AMAT, TER, STX; MarketWatch highlighted Intel, Micron, and Marvell gains.

candidate_relative_strength.evidence: INTC was reported up roughly 6-10% premarket and MU around 4-6% premarket on fresh company/analyst catalysts.

headline_risk.evidence: Guardian and Barron's reported that the Fed held rates but signaled possible hikes and unsettled markets; Juneteenth closure tomorrow may also reduce follow-through.

INTC.top_blocker: Awaiting first-hour VWAP/opening-range confirmation after a large premarket headline gap.

swing_thesis.theory: INTC can extend over 2-5 trading days if the Apple domestic-chip manufacturing headline pulls institutional rotation into U.S. semiconductor manufacturing while Nasdaq stabilizes after the Fed selloff.
swing_thesis.driver: Apple-related domestic chip manufacturing catalyst plus semiconductor relief leadership.
confirmation_signals: INTC holds above 126.50 after the first 30-60 minutes.
Price remains above VWAP with rising relative volume.
SMH and QQQ remain green after the open.
invalidation_signals: The Apple headline is denied, diluted, or treated as non-material.
Nasdaq reverses lower while VIX rises above 18.5.

INTC.execution_condition: Buy only if INTC trades in the 126.00-129.50 area, holds above VWAP after the first 30-60 minutes, and SMH/QQQ are not reversing lower.
INTC.reasoning: MarketWatch showed INTC near 128.89 premarket while Yahoo historical data showed the latest close near 121.10, so the 126.50 entry is anchored within today's realistic quote range and passed the live quote check. The catalyst is fresh and liquid, but the profile's lesson on crowded gaps requires VWAP confirmation before execution.
catalysts: President Trump announced an Apple-Intel domestic chip design/manufacturing collaboration.
Semiconductor group rebound after the Fed-driven selloff.
U.S. manufacturing and supply-chain narrative attracting attention.
risks: Premarket gap fades if traders sell the headline after the open.
Fed-rate worries push Nasdaq and SMH back below opening ranges.
Headline lacks concrete economics or is walked back.
